why: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was not set in the build environment on 2026-10-25.
what_it_does: Runs the same 60 questions through all five arms with Claude reading the question (all arms), reading passages (A) and writing SQL (B); 3 reruns to measure how much answers change. Overwrites this file with results.
cost_estimate_usd: assumed under 5 dollars: about 60 x 5 arms x 3 reruns answers, 1 to 3 calls each, a few thousand input tokens per call at $2 per million
